items.title: Define deterministic PLAN structural-gate evaluation and mode resolution
items.context: Consume the registered complete coverage basis and normalized topology; emit stable AT codes under flat project observe/warn/enforce policy, with partial or unsupported basis non-pass and no caller-forged status.

happy.desc: M1: With a registered verifier-issued current PLAN basis whose status is complete and whose normalized topology is basis-closed, the canonical evaluator returns structuralPass=true, a deterministic ordered row/code set, and the identical semantic result consumed by direct core evaluation, the CLI handler, and PLAN→DEV lifecycle evaluation.

edge.desc: M1: Missing, partial, unsupported, stale, closure-stale, signature/digest-tampered, required-adapter-missing, or aggregate-projection-tampered basis inputs never pass; each produces its documented stable AT_* diagnostic and partial/unsupported remain INCONCLUSIVE even when the declared topology is internally closed.

M1: The flat project observe/warn/enforce resolver preserves the same canonical ordered diagnostics and evaluation result across modes; observe and warn do not block admission, enforce blocks only on the canonical non-pass result, and no fuzzy Story risk/milestone text selects a different mode.

adversarial.desc: M1: Attempts by a caller or topology payload to forge complete/status, path inventory, blind spots, exclusions, issuer/authority, mode, or pass verdict are ignored or rejected; the verifier independently re-derives the basis and lifecycle status.

M1: Starting from a clean complete basis containing C1+C2, deleting only C2 from topology fails AT_UNMAPPED_SCOPE_REF; inventing a topology path absent from the unchanged basis fails AT_TOPOLOGY_OUTSIDE_BASIS; restoring the exact clean inputs passes again.

items.title: Expose acceptance_topology_check through the production CLI and process-fact contract
items.context: Register command, handler, prompt/CLI semantics and process-fact obligations so diagnostics and gate consumption share one canonical evaluator.

happy.desc: M2: A real acceptance_topology_check CLI invocation traverses the registered production command schema and handler, reports the canonical evaluator exact ordered rows/codes/mode/read-only authority semantics, and matches the PLAN lifecycle consumer for the same Story and binding.

edge.desc: M2: Unsupported arguments, malformed Story/binding inputs, and JSON/text output variants fail or render deterministically without allowing caller-supplied result/status/mode/authority fields, lifecycle writes, executable evidence, or a second writable acceptance matrix.

M2: The command fact, basis fact, producer, verifier, PLAN gate consumer, phase allowlist, freshness/material binding, rationale, and prompt guidance are all registered consistently in process-fact levels/registry and expose the intended gate-consumed semantics.

adversarial.desc: M2: In isolated mutations, removing or mismatching any one of the CLI command registration, schema/handler route, canonical evaluator consumption, process-fact/level entry, producer/verifier declaration, PLAN gate consumer, or rationale makes the process-fact contract or production-path smoke fail; exact restoration makes the clean contract pass.

M2: Removing the mechanical handler/gate/process-fact consumer while leaving role prompt text intact cannot pass the contract or admit DEV; conversely removing prompt guidance while retaining code is detected by the prompt/process-fact contract rather than silently treated as full dual-layer coverage.

items.title: Integrate the structural check into PLAN to DEV without executable-evidence coupling
items.context: Allow typed genuinely new planned producer-consumer declarations while rejecting missing/unmapped edges and prompt-only facts; preserve deterministic legacy, docs-only and single-outcome behavior.

happy.desc: M3: In enforce mode, a Story with a confirmed ledger, current complete PLAN basis, basis-closed topology, and frozen intents enters DEV through the canonical lifecycle gate without running commands, requiring verificationEvidence, requiring an implementation transcript, or writing a completion fact.

M3: A genuinely new producer-to-consumer path whose non-existent endpoints are owned by a frozen proofstory.verification_planned_path_declaration.v1 with valid endpoint roles, file declarations, scope refs, symbols/facts, relation, and output fact is verifier-derived into the PLAN basis and may enter DEV without pretending the code already exists.

edge.desc: M3: Legacy bindings, docs-only claims, and single-outcome Stories receive deterministic compatibility treatment: no fabricated runtime mutation/transcript is required, legacy behavior does not retroactively hard-block outside configured policy, and every applicable structural obligation remains explicit.

M3: The same failing structural report is visible but non-blocking in observe/warn and blocking in enforce; rollback from enforce to warn changes only admission behavior and does not rewrite diagnostics, artifacts, or prior failure history.

adversarial.desc: M3: Missing topology/basis edges, unmapped basis refs, unjustified exclusions, topology paths outside basis, orphan endpoints, uncovered must intents, required mutation/transcript declarations, or prompt-only facts block enforce-mode PLAN→DEV with stable AT_* codes and cannot be bypassed by prose.

M3: A free-form future path, unknown declaration/endpoint, wrong role, missing files/scope ref, declaration semantic restatement/drift, or planned topology edge not independently derived into the basis fails with the documented AT_PLANNED_PATH_* code; a topology-owned string cannot create a new canonical fact.

M3: PLAN admission remains structural-only and does not require or claim Wave 2A critic identity/receipt/exclusion approval mechanics, Wave 3 actual-diff reconciliation/executable mutation/transcript evidence, pre_review_check, or production readiness; tests fail if those later-wave facts become prerequisites or are emitted as Wave 2 completion.

items.title: Prove structural totality, compatibility and mutation behavior
items.context: Add focused production-path tests for complete pass, basis/topology omission, invented planned path, partial/unsupported basis, mode behavior, docs-only/single-outcome cases, clean restoration and stable codes; update user-facing CLI documentation where needed.
